notes.subject: tok piksa
notes.rationale: משל is a pithy maxim or simile/parable; 'tok piksa' catches the metaphorical saying sense.

notes.subject: ol tok pas
notes.rationale: חידות are riddles/dark sayings — deliberately opaque speech the psalm then unfolds.

notes.subject: אפתחה / אביעה
notes.rationale: Two parallel first-person verbs, 'open' and 'gush forth', both of the mouth — pouring image, water metaphor lost in Tok Pisin.

translation: Bai mi opim maus bilong mi long tok piksa; bai mi pulap autim ol tok pas, bilong taim bipo.
